column1: # Planted faults for the rMQR image decoder's format reads that stop early (rmqr-decoder.md, Decisions, failed-decode cost): the read at
# a corrected scale, which takes a valid word only, and the perspective gate, which takes a copy within a bit of the version's words.
# Also the lookups they rest on, the affine sample and the rounding of its sums, and the full read kept at the finder's own scale.
# Against those classes (2026-10-29) 10 of the 11 are caught. Not caught: the full read at the finder's own scale made exact only. A copy
# a few bits off at that scale also reads through the outline frames, which take a copy within 3 bits. Outside those classes, on rMQR
# renders with 1 to 3 of the copy's modules flipped, crisp, turned and keystoned, every read held under this fault, and only images
# that failed anyway reported another status (a probe, 2026-10-29).
